verdict.rationale: ReelMimic documents its concurrency limits as configuration: BUILDERS/MAX_AGENTS set how many agents work on one video at once (default 6) and the cap across all projects (default 12). It also states that a job pauses when it hits a limit and can resume where it stopped. Queue behavior for batch rendering is thin: there is no documentation of how jobs beyond the global cap are queued, ordered or scheduled, so pipeline planning is only partly supported. Missing for 10: documented queue semantics when the cross-project cap is reached (waiting, ordering, priority), batch-rendering throughput guidance, details on which limits trigger pause/resume, independent or hands-on corroboration.
